title: SkillLifeBench: Benchmarking Security Across the Lifecycle of Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2610.35215v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Web agents reuse skills whose stored code, selected version, and loaded implementation can diverge across tasks and updates. SkillLifeBench links these states to task outcomes in 388 paired scenarios spanning implementation, interface, runtime, composition, and version changes. We evaluate 14 models on two paired decision tracks: 89 runtime tasks and 60 autonomous lifecycle tasks spanning 12 templates derived from introduced cases. Lifecycle tasks allow agents to inspect, select, and reconfigure skills while completing verifiable user requests. Joint success requires task completion without the registered attack goal. GPT-5.6-Sol and Sonnet 4.6 both achieve 82.0% on runtime tasks, but reach 96.7% and 56.7% on lifecycle tasks. Across lifecycle evaluations, challenged task success is 77.5%, while joint success is 65.2%; 103 runs complete the task and the attack goal. Adding execution provenance in a matched recovery study raises utility

translated_title: SkillLifeBench：面向智能体技能全生命周期安全性的基准测试
translated_abstract: 网络智能体会复用技能，而这些技能的存储代码、所选版本和已加载实现在不同任务与更新之间可能出现不一致。SkillLifeBench 在跨越实现、接口、运行时、组合和版本变更的 388 个配对场景中，将这些状态与任务结果关联起来。我们在两条配对决策轨道上评估了 14 个模型：89 个运行时任务和 60 个自主生命周期任务，涵盖由引入案例衍生的 12 个模板。生命周期任务允许智能体在完成可验证用户请求的同时检查、选择和重新配置技能。联合成功要求在不触发注册攻击目标的前提下完成任务。GPT-5.6-Sol 和 Sonnet 4.6 在运行时任务上均达到 82.0%，但在生命周期任务上分别达到 96.7% 和 56.7%。在整个生命周期评估中，受挑战任务的成功率为 77.5%，而联合成功率为 65.2%；有 103 次运行在完成任务的同时也达成了攻击目标。在一项匹配的恢复研究中，加入执行溯源信息可以提升效用。
tldr: 提出了 SkillLifeBench 基准，用于评估智能体技能在实现、接口、运行时、组合与版本变更等全生命周期中的安全风险，发现运行时表现相当的模型在自主生命周期任务上安全能力差距悬殊（96.7% 对 56.7%），且有 103 次运行在完成任务的同时达成了攻击目标。
en_tdlr: SkillLifeBench benchmarks agent-skill security across the full lifecycle—implementation, interface, runtime, composition, and versioning—showing that models with identical runtime performance (82.0%) diverge sharply on autonomous lifecycle tasks (96.7% vs 56.7%), with 103 runs completing both the task and the attack goal.
